# Stage 5: LightGBM (generated by src/avm/stage5_gbm.py)

Target = sale price at the Jan 1 trend level, neutral season (Stage 3). GBMs predict at the Dec (Y-1) trend level, neutral month-of-year, from data through Y-1. mdape_ln = level-neutral MdAPE (each method's ratios divided by its own median ratio): the headline accuracy measure. **PRD/PRB against sale prices lean regressive** (price noise in the denominator).
